summary: Stablecoin Development Corp (NYSE American: SDEV, formerly NovaBay Pharmaceuticals) filed a routine Form 8-K containing Items 2.02 and 8.01, disclosing preliminary unaudited quarter-end balance sheet information and digital asset holdings as of September 30, 2026. The company disclosed holding 2,321,910,691 SKY tokens by October 2, 2026, roughly 10% of total SKY supply, valued at approximately $180.2 million based on a $0.07764 SKY price, up from $119.2 million on June 30, 2026. Approximately $7.2 million cash on hand, no outstanding debt, and 34.6 million SKY earned in staking rewards with none sold to date.
